tags.name: Timber
tags.description: Models where sawn or worked wood dominates the look — the inside of the wood: planks, beams, barrels, crates, furniture, scaffolding and the wooden parts of buildings. The outside of a trunk or branch falls under bark; models with both a cut face and bark carry both tags.

tags.name: Bark
tags.description: Models where the outside of a trunk or branch dominates the look — bark: trees, branches, roots, stumps and rough trunks. Sawn or worked wood falls under timber; trunks and stumps with a cut face carry both tags.

tags.name: Metal
tags.description: Models where metal dominates the look or is the working part: tools and weapons, anvils and grindstones, locks, keys and levers, bars, grates and fittings, lanterns and torches, and the iron and copper from the resources kit. Gold and silver are listed separately under precious-metal. A barrel or chest counts for its hoops and fittings, and so carries both timber and metal.

tags.name: Paper
tags.description: Paper and parchment: books, scrolls, maps and the journal, open and closed.

tags.name: Stone
tags.description: Worked stone: walls, floors, tiles, columns, stairs, quay walls, paving and stepping stones — stone that someone has laid or hewn. The raw rocks and boulders are under rock.

tags.name: Rock
tags.description: Raw stone as it lies in the landscape: boulders, pebbles, gravel, rubble, rock formations and the mountains. Hewn and laid stone is under stone.

tags.name: Textile
tags.description: Cloth, leather and rope work: tent canvas and canopies, bedding, sacks, the textile stack from the resources kit, the balloon with its baskets, and the wrapped handles of tools and torches.

tags.name: Flora
tags.description: What grows or has grown: trees, stumps, branches, roots and tree trunks, flowers, grass, cattail, mushrooms, cacti, grain and the weeds coming through floors and walls. The living, leafy part additionally carries foliage.

tags.name: Foliage
tags.description: The greenery itself: leafy trees, conifers, palms, grass clumps and grass patches, plants, lily pads and grain. Bare branches, stumps, trunks and dead trees carry only flora.

tags.name: Ceramic
tags.description: Pottery and fired clay: jugs, pitchers, vases, plates, bowls, pots and bottles, and the roof tiles of the fantasy-town and village kits.

tags.name: Bone
tags.description: Bone: the loose bones, ribcage and skull of the halloween kit, and the bone in the meat — the hams of the restaurant kit and the set plates of the dungeon kit.

tags.name: Candle
tags.description: Candle wax: the candles from dungeon, props and halloween — loose, thin, melted, triple, lit and snuffed — plus the wall shelf with candles and the decorated floor tile one stands on.

tags.name: Glass
tags.description: Glass: bottles and potions, the windows of the village kit and the sailing ships with their windows, and the glass in lanterns, street lamps, compass and magnifying glass.

tags.name: Light
tags.description: Burns and gives light: the lit candles and torch of the dungeon kit, the lanterns of halloween and Taaleiland's lighthouse. Snuffed candles, lamps and torches don't carry it.

tags.name: Rope
tags.description: Rope and cord: the rope bundles from the rpgtools kit, the rigging in masts, rope fences and the rope railings of the village kit, the well and the bell pull, the handles of sack and bucket, the wrapped torch handles and the balloon's lines.

tags.name: Fauna
tags.description: Animal, apart from bone: the shells and starfish from the beach and the two fish from the survival kit.

tags.name: Precious Metal
tags.description: Gold and silver: the bars, nuggets and stacks from the resources kit, the coins from the dungeon and prototype kits, the gold key and the gold-trimmed chest. Copper and iron are under metal.

tags.name: Nature
tags.description: What is already there without anyone doing anything: ground, trees, plants, seabed and rocks. Derived from the models themselves, so not tracked in catalog/tags.json.

tags.name: Structure
tags.description: What has been built: building kits, structures, stairs and bridges, fences. Derived from the models themselves, so not tracked in catalog/tags.json.

tags.name: Object
tags.description: Loose things you place or pick up: furniture, ships, food, chests, resources, tools, signs, items and lights. Derived from the models themselves, so not tracked in catalog/tags.json.

tags.name: Kenney
tags.description: Kits from Kenney (kenney.nl). One hand, one scale: everything comes from the same tile and the props fit together. Derived from the models themselves, so not tracked in catalog/tags.json.

tags.name: KayKit
tags.description: Kits from Kay Lousberg (kaylousberg.com): dungeon, forest, halloween, resources, restaurant and rpgtools. Consistent style and level of detail across the set. Derived from the models themselves, so not tracked in catalog/tags.json.

tags.name: Quaternius
tags.description: Kits from Quaternius (quaternius.com): fantasy-props and quaternius-nature. Derived from the models themselves, so not tracked in catalog/tags.json.

tags.name: Animation
tags.description: Carries its own animations in the .glb — chests and doors that open and close, a lever that flips, a compass that opens. Derived from the models themselves, so not tracked in catalog/tags.json.

tags.name: Modular
tags.description: Clicks onto the grid with matching pieces: the walls, roofs, pillars and floors of the three building kits. You don't place them loose but build something out of them, and they only fit within their own kit. Derived from the models themselves, so not tracked in catalog/tags.json.

tags.name: Assembly
tags.description: Not one thing but a little scene that's finished as it stands: a set table, a stack of crates, a chest full of bottles, the bars and stacks from the resources kit. Derived from the models themselves, so not tracked in catalog/tags.json.
